metrics: Latest reported positive value in each frozen World Bank series. Population of Vatican City and Taiwan uses undated GeoNames estimates. Missing comparable GDP and Svalbard-only statistics are left empty. GDP is nominal, current US dollars. Area includes inland water; no area vintage is implied.
comparisons: Country-based empirical standing: 1 + 99 * (lower-valued countries + (tied countries - 1) / 2) / (available countries - 1). Lowest=1, highest=100; ties share their midrank. The 197-country reference set is fixed, independent of filters. Svalbard is excluded. Arithmetic means use only available values. Years can differ, explicitly shown on each metric.
citySelection: Largest GeoNames populated places by stored population, unique names; these are not uniform metropolitan-area definitions. One city for Monaco, Singapore and Vatican City.
